description:
Rambo Savage 2.0 is a single rear-hub fat-tire electric hunting bike — not all-wheel drive. 750W–1000W hub motor, 48V battery, Kenda 24×4" all-terrain tires, 300 lb load rating, 68 lb without battery (battery 7 lb), up to 30 mph. It is Rambo’s #1-selling fat-tire hunting bike. For true dual-hub AWD, see the Megatron 4.0 AWD or Krusader 3.0 AWD.

This is the bike that started it all.

Before there was a Megatron. Before there was a Krusader. There was the Savage — the bike that put Rambo on the map and made "electric hunting bike" a category worth taking seriously. Ten years later, the Savage 2.0 is still the #1-selling fat tire electric bike in its class, and it's earned every bit of that reputation the hard way — in mud, snow, sand, and standing timber.

Most electric bikes are built for the pavement. The Savage 2.0 was built for everywhere else. Trails. Fields. Creek bottoms. Gravel roads. Wherever you need to go to get on game or just get away — this bike gets you there, and gets you there quiet.

Built Different. Priced for Everyone.
Don't judge this bike by its price tag. Rambo's entry-level lineup is engineered better than most of the "premium" bikes on the market. While other brands cut corners on hub motor controllers to hit a price point, we spend the extra hours dialing ours in — which means a smoother, more responsive ride every time you twist the throttle, whether you're climbing a ridge or easing up on a stand.

Why Hunters and Riders Keep Choosing the Savage 2.0

⚡ 750W–1000W hub motor — real torque for hills, mud, and loaded packs, without the price of a mid-drive
🛞 Kenda 24" x 4" all-terrain fat tires — floats over mud, sand, snow, gravel, and roots instead of fighting through it
🔇 Near-silent operation — cover ground without announcing yourself, whether you're still hunting or just don't want to spook the woods
🔋 48V battery system — enough range for a full morning in the timber or a full day of trail riding
📦 Rack-ready — built to run Rambo's full accessory lineup: racks, bags, bow mounts, and more
💰 Best value fat tire e-bike under $2,000 — Rambo build quality without the flagship price tag
🇺🇸 Lifetime frame warranty — built in America, backed for as long as you own it

Who Rides the Savage 2.0?
This bike wasn't built for one type of rider — it was built for anyone who needed a fat tire electric bike that actually holds up. Hunters use it to close the distance on public land without spooking every deer in the section. Trail riders use it because it shrugs off singletrack, gravel, and washed-out roads. Weekend adventurers use it because it's the most bike you can get without spending $3,000-plus.

Chasing whitetail through creek bottoms, hauling gear back from a stand, or just need a dependable off-road electric bike that won't quit on you? The Savage 2.0 is the one that started this whole thing — see how it stacks up against the rest of the lineup in our 2026 electric hunting bike buyer's guide.

Ten years at the top. Thousands of riders. One bike that started it all.
